body:
Updates public-facing branding from ``@taurus-ai/swarm-spawner-ai-sdk`` / ``@taurus-ai/swarm-spawner`` to ``@gridera/migrate-sdk`` / ``@gridera/migrate``.

Files changed:
- ``package.json``: package name, description, repository URL, peer/dev dependency names
- ``package-lock.json``: updated package/dependency names
- ``README.md``: install/import examples and links
- ``src/index.ts``: import paths and code examples in docstrings
- ``tests/ai-sdk-executor.test.ts``: import paths for test types

Public API class names (``SwarmSpawner``, ``ModelExecutor``, etc.) remain unchanged to preserve compatibility with existing consumers.
title: Rebrand Swarm Spawner AI SDK → GRIDERA Migrate SDK
